n10314017d4.headline: Fernandez: Obtaining Investment Rating Is a Big and Important Thing for Serbia
n10314017d4.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić highlighted that obtaining an investment credit rating is important as some investors, including pension funds, require it to invest in countries.
n10314017d4.why: An investment rating affects a country's ability to attract foreign investment and influences borrowing costs and economic growth prospects.
